newsitem.title: HONG KONG: National Elec sells HK$225 mln property.
newsitem.headline: National Elec sells HK$225 mln property.

text.p: National Electronics Holdings Ltd said on Monday it had agreed to sell a 13,742 square feet office floor at Nine Queen's Road in Hong Kong's Central district to a third party for HK$225.37 million. The company said it had received a HK$67.61 million deposit and the deal would be completed on May 9.
It said the net proceeds would be used as additional working capital and to fund future investment projects. The property sale would give rise to a profit of HK$9.62 million, it added.
Its shares were unchanged at HK$0.495 in late morning.
